comments.name: Harvansh Chaudhary
comments.text:
I love Nano Banana so much, and I had to take this one step further.

I ran my own set of prompts for identity-lock logic twice - first to generate the initial person-alone-on-sofa scene, and again for the final hugging portrait. Then I used a video model that generates the 5-second Reunion Moment. It handles the full cinematic transition from the loved one sitting alone, to me moving into the frame, sitting down, and ending in a perfect hug.
🥹🥹

comments.name: J Stephen Little Jr
comments.text:
These tools are awesome for fun & casual use of image "restoration," but not for evidence, journalism, or genealogy. (Autoregressive models such as Nano Banana and GPT-4o Imagine Generation don't actually "restore" or even modify an image; they generate new images, whole cloth, based on the seed image, the user prompt, and their training data.)

Professional genealogists have guidance on this use:
1) Always Label,
2) Cite Original, and
3) Use for Illustration, not Evidence. 

https://t.co/MSXUJHrQVt
